findings.evidence: Bridge(test_mode=False) leaves _port=None; FixedExecutor is only a Protocol; no concrete executor, deployment loader, main entry or executable six-action CLI exists.
findings.required: Implement actual bounded stdlib executor and fixed deployment/CLI, not a production-shaped mock.

findings.evidence: FixedNativePort.launch never writes house-price-execution.json or house-price-solution.py. Snapshot/selected_code not consumed. It calls git add for files that may not exist.
findings.required: Stage opened immutable source and per-intent config before commit, derive actual config hash, and test resulting Git blob bytes.

findings.evidence: Bridge passes parent_run_id into FixedNativePort.launch parameter parent_experiment. These are different UUID identities. FixedNativePort lacks verified_dev/final_artifact_binding implementations.
findings.required: Map selected parent run to its immutable experiment binding, open native runner receipt and regrade actual files via fixed root helpers.

findings.evidence: No verified artifact_sha256 exposed by read_public_result, so evaluated controller cannot supply required final lock args. Canonical final lock file is not published.
findings.required: Publish only opened verified final artifact hash on nativeDONE; lock exact requested IDs/hashes; save canonical lock bytes once.

findings.evidence: Any final_refit can bypass _assert_no_uncertain; gap between TrustedIo admission and .bridge-uncertain marker is unaccounted if crash; attempts counted from bound bindings only.
findings.required: One durable attempt intent fence before side effects, immutable terminal binding facts and uncertainty blocks all later admissions including final. Count all attempts/failures, one repair only under frozen rule.

findings.evidence: _bindings reads and sorts unbounded before count/size caps, follows ancestor symlinks; JSON fields can send TypeError past safe envelope. Native parser validates selected record only, bool sourceSize accepted, optional time/reason and duplicate others not validated. A function-local import violates repository rule.
findings.required: Fail-closed bounded descriptor reads, strict complete native schema, exact types/keys, top-level imports and action-bound safe responses.

qualification: 12faux tests prove limited dispatch/field checks only; no finalproduction orR1claim. Original bytes preserved for failure lineage.
